newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank to triple disaster loans in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China bank to triple disaster loans in 1996.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of China would triple its loans for disaster relief work in 1996 to six billion yuan ($723 million) compared with last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
The state-owned bank had granted loans totalling three billion yuan ($361 million) for relief work in the first seven months of the year, Xinhua quoted bank president Shi Jiliang as saying.
The bank granted more than two billion yuan ($241 million) in disaster relief loans in 1995, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.

China has been hit this year by a string of disasters including droughts, earthquakes and floods. Widespread storms and floods have killed at least 2,700 people and caused more than 52.4 billion yuan ($6.3 billion) in damage.
